description: Undoes a b2p_convert run from the ledger with the plugin's own Undo: removes the virtual beams, the plates/solids, the rigid links and construction-joint links, the converted loads and the nodes it made, gives the stages and boundary groups back, then puts the beams back with their beam loads, temperatures, releases, offsets, moved nodal loads and structure-group membership, and reads the model back. Resumable: if CIVIL NX refuses some deletes or the connection goes, the call says what is left and calling again with the same runId carries on (also after a background job that stopped). Afterwards (tidy, default on) it also removes the thickness records and the 'B2P mesh' group the run created when nothing uses them — the plugin's own Undo leaves both. Default run: the latest not undone. Previews unless apply: true; on the website the apply runs as a background job.

runId.description: Ledger run id; default = the latest b2p_convert run not yet undone.

tidy.description: Also remove the thickness records and mesh group this run created, when unused.

name: b2p_undo
title: Beam to Plate — undo a conversion
